title: Channel Trial Experience Audit for LLM Commercialization
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Audit and optimize first-touch trial experiences across three commercial channels (self-serve API, cloud marketplace listing, and partner-integrated SDK) to improve conversion velocity and reduce technical churn during proof-of-concept (PoC).
description_2: Scope: map the end-to-end trial flows for each channel, instrument and measure key telemetry, run 10 pilot PoCs with representative customers, identify top 3 friction points per channel, produce prioritized fixes and a lightweight ops playbook for sales/SEs.
acceptance_criteria: 1) End-to-end flow maps for all three channels stored in Confluence and linked from this ticket. 2) Instrumented telemetry dashboards showing time-to-first-successful-request (TTFSR), first-24h error rate, and trial retention at 7 days for each channel. 3) List of prioritized product/infra/design fixes with owner and recommended timeline. 4) Pilot results from at least 10 customers with replication notes.
methodology: - Workshops with Sales/SEs to capture real PoC scripts. - Lightweight UX walkthroughs (recorded) for self-serve and marketplace flows. - Engineering spike to add TTFSR and detailed error buckets to trial telemetry. - Run synthetic workload to validate latency expectations across regions. - Pilot program coordination and post-mortems.
risks_and_tradeoffs: - Instrumentation adds minor infra cost and potential noise; balance sampling vs completeness. - Marketplace/partner flows may have vendor-imposed constraints (token exchange, redirect UX) that require product-level fallbacks. - Prioritization must weigh conversion impact vs engineering effort; initial focus on high-leverage fixes under 2w.
deliverables: - Confluence: /commercialization/channel-trial-audit (flow maps, recordings). - Dashboards: trial-ttfsr, trial-error-buckets, trial-retention. - Patch list: 1-page prioritization with owners. - SE playbook: PoC checklist and fallbacks.
